baseline_models.focus_anchor: The achieved arrival in جَاءَ ٱلْحَقُّ is followed by coordinated negations over ٱلْبَاطِلُ, يُبْدِئُ, and يُعِيدُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Stable reality has become present; what departs from truth and is idle from effective work is denied both the opening phase and the returning phase. The clause therefore removes falsehood's whole productive cycle, not merely its final victory.

activation_trace.role: Coming and obtaining make truth's presence an achieved event that conditions the following negations.
Fixed correspondence with reality supplies the stable term against which falsehood has no standing.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the first half of a complete production cycle.
Idleness from benefit and work turns falsehood's negated agency into functional sterility.
Return after departure supplies the second half of the cycle that falsehood cannot perform.

changed_reading.before: Truth has arrived, and falsehood neither begins nor repeats.
changed_reading.after: Truth's achieved presence closes the entire production cycle: what lacks truth can neither originate an effective reality nor bring one back.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ places an imperative utterance beside the branch idiom for one who is silent and neither begins nor answers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse stages an asymmetry of voice. Truth is made publicly speakable, while falsehood as unreal assertion is left unable to open an answering discourse or return a reply.

activation_trace.role: Producing speech by articulation gives the truth side an explicit voiced act.
Claiming what has no reality identifies falsehood here as counter-assertion rather than an independent substance.
The exact image of silence that neither begins nor answers converts the paired verbs into failed counter-speech.

changed_reading.before: The two negated verbs state a generic inability to act.
changed_reading.after: Say it: truth is voiced, while falsehood is left without an initiating word or an answering return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier challenge imagines bodies torn into complete dispersal and then a new creation. That sequence activates the focus pair as origination and reconstitution: falsehood possesses neither the first creative act nor the power to restore after disintegration.

activation_trace.role: Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the terminal disassembly that any genuine return must overcome.
Creative origination supplies the ontological domain for يُبْدِئُ.
New occurrence after severance supplies reconstitution as a fresh event rather than mere repetition.

structural_cues: 34:7 orders total tearing before the disputed prospect of a new creation, matching the focus's beginning-return polarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disintegration followed by new creation and the focus supplies the begin-return pair; I infer that يُعِيدُ includes reconstitution after death. A live alternative is the broader sense of repeating any effective act.

changed_reading.after: Falsehood can neither originate creation nor reconstitute what has been torn apart; its denial of new creation displays its own incapacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents do speak: after clear signs are recited and truth comes, they call the message fabrication and magic. This revises literal muteness into derivative sterility. Falsehood can issue reactive labels, but it cannot supply an independent truth-bearing beginning or restore those labels once truth exposes their diversion.

activation_trace.role: Following in ordered succession makes recitation the prior communicative event to which the labels react.
A lie turned away from truth supplies the first derivative counter-label.
Reality fixed against falsehood identifies what the counter-label fails to displace.
The exact contextual arrival of truth anticipates the focus declaration and fixes the sequence.
Diversion and deception supply the second reactive label and prove that false speech still occurs.

structural_cues: 34:43 orders recitation, dismissive labeling, the arrival of truth, and renewed dismissive labeling before 34:49 denies falsehood beginning and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual hostile speech after truth's arrival; I infer that 'begin' means non-derivative, reality-bearing production rather than making a first sound. The literal silence idiom remains a possible description of falsehood's condition after the declaration.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood is simply unable to speak or answer.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood can emit labels, but only parasitically after truth arrives; it cannot originate a reality-bearing claim or renew its labels as effective truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding declaration says that the Lord casts with truth; the focus then says truth has come. Read as launch followed by arrival, the two negated imperfects report the resulting disablement of falsehood's capacity to start or restart.

activation_trace.role: Throwing and casting far supplies a directed launch whose arrival is announced in the focus.
Rapid propulsion sharpens the launch as an effective motion rather than a static possession of truth.
Establishing and manifesting truth makes the cast payload an act of disclosure that disables its opposite.

structural_cues: 34:48-49 repeats بِٱلْحَقِّ/ٱلْحَقُّ across the ayah boundary and moves from 'casts' to 'came' to two negated imperfects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting immediately followed by arrival; I supply the launch-to-impact arrow and read the negations as its result. A live alternative treats 34:48 and 34:49 as coordinate declarations without physical sequencing.

changed_reading.before: Truth is present and falsehood is abstractly powerless.
changed_reading.after: Truth has been launched and has landed; falsehood is shown in the post-impact state, unable to initiate or restart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same casting verb frames the focus in opposite epistemic directions: the Lord who knows hidden things casts truth, guidance reaches the messenger through hidden imparting, but the rejecters cast at the unseen from a distant place. The focus becomes the hinge between knowledge that arrives and conjecture that never establishes contact.

activation_trace.role: Directed casting supplies truth's movement from the knowing source toward arrival.
Imparting knowledge in hidden fashion supplies a successful channel from unseen source to recipient.
The repeated casting image now belongs to the rejecters and functions as an outward throw from remoteness.
What is concealed from sight supplies the inaccessible object about which their remote casting makes claims.

structural_cues: 34:48 names the caster as knower of hidden things, while 34:53 repeats يَقْذِفُونَ with 'the unseen' and 'from a distant place'; 34:49 stands between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated verb, contrasting agents, successful revelation, and remoteness; I infer a contrast of epistemic direction and contact. A live alternative reads both casting clauses simply as forceful speech.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood cannot perform a beginning or a repetition.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood's failure is also failed epistemic contact: it throws claims toward the hidden from afar, while truth arrives from the knower of the hidden through revelation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence removes every recovery route: there is no escape, seizure is immediate, belief cannot be reached from afar, and a barrier intervenes. The negated beginning-return pair therefore acquires temporal finality: falsehood cannot open a late alternative or restore the missed relation to truth.

activation_trace.role: Failure of reaching or escape supplies the closed opportunity immediately after the focus.
Seizure and capture make the closure operative rather than merely argumentative.
Reaching by extension names the recovery attempt that distance now defeats.
An intervening barrier supplies the final mechanism preventing return to what is desired.

structural_cues: 34:51-54 progresses from panic and no escape, through too-late profession and unreachable access, to a final barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial non-reach and a closing barrier; I map that spatial closure onto temporal irreversibility in يُعِيدُ. A live alternative confines the focus to falsehood's present impotence and treats the later scene independently.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood cannot repeat an effective act.
changed_reading.after: Once truth has arrived, falsehood cannot create a late counter-beginning or recover the opportunity it has lost; no restart remains available.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus root ع و د to ع د د, so it is morphologically distant from the direct return sense. It remains anchored to يُعِيدُ and to a branch explicitly joining counted time with recurrence; downstream prose should present it only as a temporal overlay, never as the lexical replacement for 'return.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُعِيدُ at focus word 8, within the balanced beginning-return pair.

activation_trace.role: Counted time and its recurrence overlay 'return' with entry into a repeatable temporal series.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood cannot do the act again.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood cannot turn its moment into a counted recurrence or secure another cycle after truth's arrival.

strongest_changes: 34:7 turns the begin-return pair into creation and reconstitution across complete disintegration.
34:43 forces revision of literal muteness: falsehood speaks, but only through derivative labels after truth comes.
34:48-53 frames the focus as a hinge between truth cast from knowledge and conjecture cast from distance.
34:51-54 gives 'does not return' an irreversible no-recovery horizon.
summary.what_was_special: The exact casting mirror around the focus and the earlier exact phrase 'truth came' converted an abstract opposition into directional and temporal mechanisms. The branch idiom of silence remained live, but context narrowed it from physical muteness to non-generative counter-speech.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يُبْدِئُ/يُعِيدُ primarily invokes creation-resurrection or general initiative and repetition.
Whether the launch-impact geometry should enter final prose or remain a contained material analogy.
Whether the no-recovery horizon is active inside 34:49 itself or is a context-induced extension from 34:51-54.
Whether the non-dominant ع د د recurrence overlay carries interpretive weight beyond exploratory wordplay.
